subject: Bluehaven: capacity intake & next meeting to vet throughput/latency
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@bluehaven.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Bluehaven discovery — next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Elena / Michael —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call: Bluehaven wants to run real-time document ingestion + retrieval generation for customer support summaries. Target SLA: 150ms p50 for short responses, and sustained 60 qps during peak windows. Key unknowns we flagged: average request size distribution, expected concurrency per region, and whether you need on-prem/private deployment for PII workflows.

Next step I'd like to schedule: a 60-minute capacity sizing call with our runtime engineers to validate throughput targets and walk through our Dedicated sizing checklist (KV cache behavior, batching tradeoffs, quantization choices). Suggested slots (PT):
- Thu Oct 21, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Oct 21, 15:00–16:00
- Fri Oct 22, 08:30–09:30

Prep items that will make the call productive:
- Your expected QPS and p50/p95 latency targets by workload (short vs long responses)
- A representative request/response sample or small test corpus (anonymized)
- Any region constraints (US East vs US West vs EU) and data residency needs

I'm attaching a short intake form and the preliminary requirements doc — if you can populate the top section before the call that saves us 15–20 minutes.

Attachments: bluehaven_prelim_requirements.pdf (summary of discovery), redwood_capacity_intake_form.xlsx (short form)

If none of those times work, tell me two windows that do and we'll match our engineers.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0143
https://redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluehaven.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@bluehaven.ai>, procurement <procurement@bluehaven.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven discovery — next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks, Tessa —

Good recap. We can confirm some preliminary numbers: baseline traffic looks like ~25 qps for chat assist and a burst profile up to 65 qps during peak hours; average request size is ~300 tokens input, 120 tokens output for summaries. Latency target: p50 <200ms for short responses and p95 <600ms (we understand p95 is tougher).

We'd like the call to focus on: whether Redwood Dedicated can hit those p50 targets with concurrent KV cache usage, recommended batch sizes, and fallback plans when GPU pool is saturated. Also, include a short section on monitoring and cost controls (token breakdowns).

Of the slots you proposed, Thu Oct 21 15:00 PT works best for our engs. Michael (cc'ed) will join as our engineering lead. Procurement is looped to track required paperwork. I can fill the intake form and share a sanitized sample of the request/response pairs (should be available by EOD Thu).

Thanks — Elena
Elena Rossi
VP Product | Bluehaven Analytics
elena.rossi@bluehaven.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluehaven.ai>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven discovery — next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Elena / Michael —

Great — thanks for the numbers, that gives us a clear starting point. Confirming our side: Markus (runtime) and I will join the 21 Oct 15:00 PT call. We'll plan a 60-minute agenda:
1) Quick architecture and assumptions (10 min)
2) Review your sample traffic and targets (15 min)
3) Live throughput scenarios and sizing (25 min)
4) Next steps: canary rollout plan + artifacts (10 min)

A couple of asks to make the session efficient:
- If you can share a small set (~50) of anonymized request/response pairs prior to the call, we'll run a quick local performance profile and come with an initial recommendation.
- Let us know expected concurrency (how many concurrent users during peak) and whether you intend to use streaming vs non-streaming responses.

Logistics: I'll create a calendar invite with a Zoom link and include a short shared doc for live notes. If you prefer Google Meet, flag that and we'll switch.

DocuSign / NDA: I saw procurement copy included — if you need an executed NDA before sharing samples, we can route a standard Redwood mutual NDA (link below).

NDA (if needed): https://redwood.ai/legal/mutual-nda-v2

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluehaven.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@bluehaven.ai>, procurement <procurement@bluehaven.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Oct 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven discovery — next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks Karthik —

15:00 PT on Oct 21 is confirmed on our side. Michael will share the anonymized sample in the next few hours (Michael — sending that now). Procurement will review the NDA link and circle back if they need redlines.

Please send the calendar invite and Zoom link; we prefer Zoom. See you on the call.

Best,
Elena
